paper_metadata.title: Excellent mechanical properties and thermal stability in a Zr gettering treated (VNb)80(TaTi)20 refractory multi-principal element alloy

evidence.quote: Refractory multi-principal element alloys (RMPEAs) have garnered attention due to their high strength at elevated temperatures.
The VNbTaTi RMPEA with a single-phase body-centered-cubic (BCC) structure has exhibited excellent mechanical properties and thermal stability.
